name: codex-orchestration
description: Two-stage classification and single-agent execution with previous-task continuity.

interface.longDescription: Activate Codex Orchestration with Turn Orchestration on, Use Orchestration, or Use Orchestration for this chat. Version 0.13.0 uses two stages only: GPT-5.6 Terra / Extra High classifies the request, then one Luna / High, Terra / Max, or Sol / High agent owns the entire task. There are no supervisors, acceptance gates, implementation checkpoints, or final-review lanes. The selected agent interprets scope, performs the work, verifies it, completes any explicitly authorized release, and writes a recommendation-led final response with an exact target state and concrete next step. When appearance materially matters, root performs the root-only visual observation and hands the evidence back to that same agent, which either corrects the work or finishes. Previous-task continuity, quiet startup, premise-mismatch checks, exact task bundles, and the compact route footer remain.
defaultPrompt: Tell me “Turn Orchestration on” for same-chat read-only, artifact, tweak, and build routing.
